description: Create complete Next.js Personal Budget Tracker application manually (all source files, configs, package.json) since npm registry is not accessible in this sandbox. The code must be correct and buildable so that Vercel can install deps and build successfully on push.
steps: Create feature branch: git checkout -b feat/budget-tracker

Create package.json with next@14, react@18, react-dom@18, typescript, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, eslint, eslint-config-next as dependencies/devDependencies. Include scripts: dev, build, start, lint.
Create next.config.mjs (or next.config.js) with minimal Next.js 14 config
Create tsconfig.json with Next.js-compatible TypeScript config (paths alias @/* -> ./src/*)
Create tailwind.config.ts with content paths for ./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
Create postcss.config.mjs with tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins
Create src/app/globals.css with @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;
Create src/app/layout.tsx - root layout with metadata (title: Budget Tracker, description), Inter font from next/font/google, semantic HTML
Create src/types/index.ts with Transaction interface {id: string, type: 'income'|'expense', amount: number, category: string, description: string, date: string} and CATEGORIES constant array
Create src/components/Header.tsx - app header with title and indigo/purple styling
Create src/components/BalanceSummary.tsx - shows total income, total expenses, net balance with color coding (green positive, red negative), card-based design

Create src/components/TransactionForm.tsx - controlled form with type toggle, amount, category dropdown, description, date inputs. Validates amount > 0 and category selected before calling onAddTransaction callback
Create src/components/TransactionList.tsx - renders transaction list with delete button per item, color-coded amounts, shows all transaction details
Create src/components/CategoryBreakdown.tsx - expense breakdown by category with progress bars showing relative spending
Create src/app/page.tsx - 'use client' main page composing all components, manages state with useState, loads/saves localStorage with useEffect, responsive grid layout
Create .gitignore with standard Next.js ignores (node_modules, .next, out, etc.)
Validate TypeScript syntax of all .ts/.tsx files using Node.js parser (since tsc is not installed)
Git add all files and commit on feat/budget-tracker branch
acceptance_criteria: All required files exist with correct TypeScript/JSX syntax
package.json has correct dependencies for Next.js 14 + React 18 + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript
All component files exist in src/components/: Header.tsx, BalanceSummary.tsx, TransactionForm.tsx, TransactionList.tsx, CategoryBreakdown.tsx
src/types/index.ts defines Transaction type and CATEGORIES array
localStorage persistence logic in page.tsx (read on mount, write on change)
Form validates amount > 0 and category selection
Responsive mobile-first layout using Tailwind classes
Semantic HTML used (header, main, section, article)
Categories include: Food, Transport, Entertainment, Bills, Shopping, Health, Other
All code committed on feat/budget-tracker branch
verification: Check all files exist with correct structure
Validate TypeScript/JSX syntax using Node.js parser on all .ts/.tsx files
Verify git log shows commit on feat/budget-tracker branch
findings: All files created successfully. TypeScript syntax validated via brace/bracket/paren balancing check with Node.js. JSON files validated via JSON.parse. Cannot run npm build/lint locally due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (npm registry blocked). Code is designed to build correctly on Vercel after push. Committed on feat/budget-tracker branch.
